extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology update from primary XML sections, figures, activity tables, and Supporting Information Table S5.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: P21S1-P21S10, P21L-series, P21S8 mutants, P21, HR2P-M2
mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper evaluates these peptides as inhibitors of MERS-CoV S-protein-mediated cell-cell fusion; EC50 values are reported in Table 1.
direct_assay_types: MERS-CoV S protein-mediated cell-cell fusion assay
mechanism_claims.limitations: Fusion inhibition is source-supported; database antibacterial or anticancer labels are not promoted to primary-paper mechanisms.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: P21S8, P21S10, P21S8Z, and HR2P-M2 inhibit pseudotyped MERS-CoV infection in Huh-7 cells, including WT, Q1020H, and Q1020R spike contexts; Calu-3 EMC/2012 pseudovirus results are reported in Supporting Information Table S1.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This supports viral entry/fusion inhibition in cell assays, not direct evidence for membrane permeabilization or broad antimicrobial killing.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Biophysical assays support interaction of P21S8 and P21S10 with the NHR peptide HR1P and formation of stable complexes consistent with blocking six-helix-bundle fusion-core assembly.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Quantitative Table S5 values were checked for mechanism support but are not activity/toxicity endpoints.

caution_findings.evidence_context: The local primary material supports antiviral fusion/entry inhibition and HR1P binding, not antimicrobial membrane permeabilization.
